title: Scheduled reevaluation hardening

environment.clock: controlled clock; no wall-clock one-minute session was run

changed.selection: --paths-file from git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD (the CI merge-base selection)
changed.note: On the committed clean tree the default working-tree selection is only the mandatory set (864 tests, 1 skipped, 0 failures, 0 errors, 239.829 s); that run also passed and is not the result claimed here.

full.note: Second run. The first run on the same commit reported 1 failure in trading_correctness (8192 run, 53 skipped, 537.025 s) while a FinBERT model load and a news probe were running on the same machine; the failing test id was not captured. trading_correctness then passed alone (257 tests, 0 failures) and this run, with nothing else running, passed. Classified as a load-sensitive test, not reproduced.

final_validation.generated_artifacts: The suites rewrite tracked performance artifacts while they run (artifacts/g8-, g13-runtime-performance.json, artifacts/p3-plan-*, tests/artifact/*baseline*.json); they were restored and are not part of this change.
final_validation.ui: NOT_RUN: no UI source changed; the cycle and status schemas are passthrough and unchanged

defects_fixed.finding: Only the first 3 held instruments outside the intake got an evidence read and only the first 10 held were evaluated; unavailable evidence was noted once, then silent.
defects_fixed.repair: Every held instrument is read and evaluated up to max_held_per_cycle (default 10), rotating least-recently-seen first with HELD_POSITION_CAP_EXCEEDED; unavailable evidence is noted again every decision_max_age_seconds.

defects_fixed.finding: A failed Screener evidence read ended the cycle FAILED before any held position's SMA stop was evaluated.
defects_fixed.repair: Cycle ends REEVALUATION_BLOCKED with EVIDENCE_READ_FAILED; the stop monitor still runs for held instruments; no model call, no baseline change.

defects_fixed.finding: Lease ownership was checked once at cycle start and loop writes were unfenced; a cycle outlasting the lease could overwrite a new owner's baselines.
defects_fixed.repair: Scheduled-cycle writes are owner-fenced; the lease is renewed before each model call; a displaced cycle records FAILED/REEVALUATION_LEASE_LOST, keeps its spent model call counted and ends its worker. An operator Stop mid-cycle still finishes normally.

defects_fixed.finding: Model-call caps were counted per loop, so reconfiguring the scope reset the hourly and daily budget.
defects_fixed.repair: Caps are counted across every loop of the Paper account.

defects_fixed.finding: A duplicate receipt id raised ValueError in memory but sqlite3.IntegrityError on SQLite.
Found on the real evidence path: held instruments were subscribed for quotes only by page-driven Paper/lifecycle requests, so a loop with no page open had no current quote for its own positions.
defects_fixed.repair: Each cycle refreshes held-position marks and their paper-portfolio-marks subscription without creating the live runtime or touching the execution gate.

defects_fixed.finding: Found on the real evidence path: every stale-to-current quote recovery bought an undwelled model call, because the prior record was a non-committed REVALIDATION_REQUIRED.
defects_fixed.repair: QUOTE_RESTORED waits min_state_dwell_seconds from the recorded loss; repeated losses inside the window are not re-recorded.

verified_unchanged: 60-second slot grid, overrun skip, RUNTIME_STALLED and PROCESS_DOWNTIME gaps without backfill (existing WorkerTests)
SQLite restart keeps tracked baselines and does not reissue an unexpired ENTER (new lock-in test)
Sub-threshold ticking quotes with advancing clocks cost zero model calls on the real Screener row/cache path
Stale, delayed, silent-feed and disconnected quotes yield REVALIDATION_REQUIRED / BLOCKED with no model call and no ledger event
No preview, handoff, order or submit path added; Live authority unchanged
not_done: Regular-session run against live providers and a real model runtime
Fill landing mid-cycle and full lifecycle stage walk were not given new tests; existing OCT1-06/08/10 suites pass unchanged
Selected candidates that are not held are not subscribed by the loop: without a Screener window their quote is stale and ENTER is blocked

implementation.note: All results below were run on this exact commit. The commit that records them changes only this receipt and the reevaluation contract (documentation).

operator_requirements: KEEP THE SCREENER OPEN DURING THE LIVE CANDIDATE-SELECTION PHASE: a selected candidate that is not held has a current quote only while a Screener window owns its subscription.
Held Paper positions do not need the Screener: the reevaluation loop keeps their quote subscription and SMA stop monitor on the server.
